description: You enter a tight chamber directly beneath the paper feed. A colossal, black rubber cylindrical platen roller rises up, forming a massive, insurmountable barrier blocking any further progress.

iron_wall.description: Thick iron plating that forms the chassis of the typewriter. Impassable.

deadend_floor.description: A dusty steel platform ending abruptly at the roller wall.

exit_south.description: The metal hatch leading south back to the ink ribbon.

platen_wall.description: A colossal rubber cylindrical platen roller that stretches infinitely to the left and right. There is absolutely no way around it.

platen_sign.description: A rusty metal sign hanging from the platen roller structure.
platen_sign.onInteract:
You read the rusty sign:
'Apostrophe warning was 100% correct. This is a complete deadend. Do not enter typewriter! Now turn back and take the main road.'
Willy mutters: 'We got shocked and inked just to read a sign telling us we shouldn't have come. Typical.'
